longDescription:
VSCodium is a community-built distribution of Microsoft's open-source VS Code codebase with telemetry disabled and without Microsoft branding. It provides a modern editor, integrated terminal, debugging, source-control integration, language tooling, and extension support.

The current release is installed from the official VSCodium Debian repository.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export LC_ALL=C
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

fail() {
    printf '%s: %s\n' 'codium' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
[ "$ARCH" = amd64 ] || fail "unsupported architecture: $ARCH"

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]; then
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl
fi

install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/keyrings /etc/apt/sources.list.d
curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o '/usr/share/keyrings/vscodium.asc' 'https://gitlab.com/paulcarroty/vscodium-deb-rpm-repo/raw/master/pub.gpg'
chmod 0644 '/usr/share/keyrings/vscodium.asc'

cat >'/etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscodium.sources' <<'EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://download.vscodium.com/debs
Suites: vscodium
Components: main
Architectures: amd64
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/vscodium.asc
EOF
chmod 0644 '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscodium.sources'

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'codium'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}\n' 'codium' | grep -Fqx 'install ok installed' || fail 'package installation was not recorded by dpkg'

apt-get clean
